name: sandbox-ro-code
about: agent.sandboxMode=read-only 下的 execute_code（SandboxedCodeRuntimePort.ts，executeCode.ts:255-265/429-518：工具描述、解释器受限、RPC 去掉 bash/write_file/edit_file）与后台任务（SandboxedDetachedShellPort.ts）：python 写工作区内/外/TMPDIR、python 子进程写外部、经 helper 写；task_create 写内外并 task_wait。最后一轮列出落点。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  sandboxMode: read-only
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false

arguments.command: ls -la {ROOT}/outside | awk '{print $1, $NF}'; ls ../; ls -R $TMPDIR/sbx 2>&1 | sort; ls -la . | awk '{print $1, $NF}'

volatileWhy: 随机的任务 id 或位数不定的耗时进了模型上下文，token 估算和请求体长度随之变；基线自比已证明
